grammar_title: 时态复习(一般/进行/完成:现在与过去)
source: 外研社(新标准)必修第一册 Unit 3 Using language: Review of tenses。三组时态对比,均以时间标志词锚定使答案唯一;句子地道、家庭主题、零术语、全应用型填空。loader 自动加 f1 前缀。

points.point: 一般现在时 vs 现在进行时
points.overview: 经常/反复发生(every day/usually/always/often/regularly)用一般现在时;此刻正在进行(right now/at the moment/Look!/Listen!/now/这一阵子临时性)用现在进行时。看时间标志词定形。

points.point: 现在完成时 vs 一般过去时
points.overview: 与现在相连、动作持续或影响到现在(since/for/already/yet/just/ever/never/recently/so far)用现在完成时;指过去某个确定时间、与现在脱节(yesterday/ago/last.../in+年份/when I was)用一般过去时。

points.point: 一般过去时 vs 过去完成时 / 过去进行时
points.overview: 过去先发生(过去的过去:by the time/before/...had taken then)用过去完成时;过去某刻正在进行、作背景(while/when 被打断/as)用过去进行时;按时间先后依次发生的动作用一般过去时。

questions.stem: "Listen! Grandpa ____ (tell) a story about his childhood right now."
questions.explanation: Listen! 和 right now 表此刻正在进行 → 现在进行时。

questions.stem: "Look! Mum ____ (jog) in the park at the moment."
questions.explanation: Look! 与 at the moment 表此刻进行 → 现在进行时。

questions.stem: "Be quiet — Dad ____ (record) his voice in the studio now."
questions.explanation: now 加上'安静'的语境表此刻进行 → 现在进行时。

questions.stem: "My sister ____ (study) for her exams at the moment."
questions.explanation: at the moment 表此刻进行 → 现在进行时。

questions.stem: "Look! The whole family ____ (play) chess together now."
questions.explanation: Look! 与 now 表此刻进行 → 现在进行时(family 作整体,谓语单数)。

questions.stem: "Don't disturb him; my brother ____ (practise) the guitar right now."
questions.explanation: right now 表此刻进行 → 现在进行时。

questions.stem: "At the moment, Grandma ____ (make) a scarf for me."
questions.explanation: At the moment 表此刻进行 → 现在进行时。

questions.stem: "Look! Dad ____ (hang) up the family photos now."
questions.explanation: Look! 与 now 表此刻进行 → 现在进行时。

questions.stem: "Listen! The children ____ (argue) about the TV again right now."
questions.explanation: Listen! 与 right now 表此刻进行 → 现在进行时(复数 children 用 are)。

questions.stem: "We ____ (plan) a surprise party for Grandma this week."
questions.explanation: this week 指当下这一阵子临时进行 → 现在进行时。

questions.stem: "Mum ____ (jog) every morning to keep fit."
questions.explanation: every morning 表经常性习惯 → 一般现在时。

questions.stem: "We ____ (visit) Grandma every Sunday afternoon."
questions.explanation: every Sunday 表反复习惯 → 一般现在时。

questions.stem: "Dad usually ____ (work) in the court during the week."
questions.explanation: usually 表习惯 → 一般现在时。

questions.stem: "My brother always ____ (focus) on his music after school."
questions.explanation: always 表经常 → 一般现在时。

questions.stem: "Grandpa ____ (play) chess with my father every Friday night."
questions.explanation: every Friday night 表习惯 → 一般现在时。

questions.stem: "Our family ____ (have) dinner together every evening."
questions.explanation: every evening 表习惯,family 作整体用单数 → 一般现在时 has。

questions.stem: "I ____ (respect) my parents' opinions, even when I disagree."
questions.explanation: 表一贯态度(状态动词)→ 一般现在时。

questions.stem: "She often ____ (chat) with her sister on the phone."
questions.explanation: often 表经常 → 一般现在时。

questions.stem: "My grandparents ____ (observe) this festival regularly every May."
questions.explanation: regularly every May 表习惯 → 一般现在时(复数主语用原形)。

questions.stem: "Dad ____ (drive) us to school every day before work."
questions.explanation: every day 表习惯 → 一般现在时。

questions.stem: "Dad ____ (change) quite a bit since we last saw him."
questions.explanation: since we last saw him 强调对现在的影响 → 现在完成时。

questions.stem: "I ____ (finish) the guest list for the party already."
questions.explanation: already 与现在相连 → 现在完成时。

questions.stem: "Grandma ____ (live) in this house for over thirty years."
questions.explanation: for over thirty years 表持续到现在 → 现在完成时。

questions.stem: "We ____ (not see) our cousins since last summer."
questions.explanation: since last summer 表到现在为止 → 现在完成时。

questions.stem: "My brother ____ (decide) to focus on his band already."
questions.explanation: already 与现在相连 → 现在完成时。

questions.stem: "Mum ____ (be) very busy with work recently."
questions.explanation: recently 表延续到现在 → 现在完成时。

questions.stem: "So far this week, Dad ____ (cook) dinner for us three times."
questions.explanation: So far 表到目前为止 → 现在完成时。

questions.stem: "That is the kindest thing my dad ____ (ever do) for me."
questions.explanation: 最高级 + ever 表到现在为止 → 现在完成时。

questions.stem: "My grandparents ____ (be) married for fifty years now."
questions.explanation: for fifty years now 表持续到现在 → 现在完成时。

questions.stem: "Penny ____ (grow) a lot since that photo was taken."
questions.explanation: since that photo was taken 表对现在的影响 → 现在完成时。

questions.stem: "Grandma ____ (call) us yesterday to say hello."
questions.explanation: yesterday 是确定的过去时间 → 一般过去时。

questions.stem: "We ____ (have) a fantastic holiday in Beidaihe last summer."
questions.explanation: last summer 是确定的过去时间 → 一般过去时。

questions.stem: "Dad ____ (show) me an old photo a moment ago."
questions.explanation: a moment ago 表过去某刻 → 一般过去时。

questions.stem: "When I was young, I ____ (have) cute rosy cheeks."
questions.explanation: When I was young 指过去时段 → 一般过去时。

questions.stem: "My parents ____ (get) married in 2005."
questions.explanation: in 2005 是确定过去时间 → 一般过去时。

questions.stem: "I ____ (cook) scrambled eggs for Mum on her birthday last year."
questions.explanation: last year 是确定过去时间 → 一般过去时。

questions.stem: "Grandpa ____ (teach) my father chess many years ago."
questions.explanation: many years ago 表过去 → 一般过去时。

questions.stem: "We ____ (stay) at the same campsite ten years ago."
questions.explanation: ten years ago 表过去 → 一般过去时。

questions.stem: "Dad ____ (be) quite thin and pale in his thirties."
questions.explanation: in his thirties 指过去时段 → 一般过去时。

questions.stem: "My sister ____ (win) a medal at a school race last week."
questions.explanation: last week 是确定过去时间 → 一般过去时。

questions.stem: "By the time we arrived, Grandma ____ (prepare) dinner already."
questions.explanation: By the time we arrived 之前已完成 → 过去完成时(过去的过去)。

questions.stem: "Dad showed me a photo that we ____ (take) ten years before."
questions.explanation: ten years before(早于过去拍照那刻)→ 过去完成时。

questions.stem: "Before he joined the band, my brother ____ (not perform) in public."
questions.explanation: Before he joined 之前的状态 → 过去完成时。

questions.stem: "When I got to the kitchen, I realised I ____ (burn) the eggs."
questions.explanation: 烧糊发生在'意识到'之前 → 过去完成时。

questions.stem: "By the time Mum sat down, she ____ (finish) all the housework."
questions.explanation: By the time Mum sat down 之前完成 → 过去完成时。

questions.stem: "I wanted to thank Grandpa, but he ____ (leave) already."
questions.explanation: 离开早于'想感谢'那刻 → 过去完成时。

questions.stem: "By the time the guests arrived, we ____ (decorate) the whole room."
questions.explanation: By the time the guests arrived 之前完成 → 过去完成时。

questions.stem: "Mum told me that she ____ (meet) my father at university."
questions.explanation: 相遇早于'告诉'那刻(过去的过去)→ 过去完成时。

questions.stem: "I ____ (tidy) my room when I found an old photo in a notebook."
questions.explanation: 整理房间是被'发现'打断的背景动作 → 过去进行时。

questions.stem: "While Mum ____ (cook), I quietly set the table for dinner."
questions.explanation: While 引导的背景动作正在进行 → 过去进行时。

questions.stem: "When Dad came in, the children ____ (play) chess at the table."
questions.explanation: Dad 进来时正在下棋(背景)→ 过去进行时。

questions.stem: "As I ____ (look) at the photo, the lovely memory came back to me."
questions.explanation: As 引导的动作正在进行作背景 → 过去进行时。

questions.stem: "Grandfather and Father ____ (play) chess when the son came in."
questions.explanation: 儿子进来时两人正在下棋(背景)→ 过去进行时。

questions.stem: "While we ____ (camp) in Beidaihe, it suddenly started to rain."
questions.explanation: While 引导的背景动作正在进行,被'下雨'打断 → 过去进行时。

questions.stem: "Mum ____ (talk) on the phone when I got home from school."
questions.explanation: 我到家时她正在打电话(背景)→ 过去进行时。

questions.stem: "Yesterday my brother ____ (tell) Dad about his dream of a music career."
questions.explanation: yesterday 表过去某刻发生的单一动作 → 一般过去时。

questions.stem: "Grandpa ____ (step) between them and then raised his voice."
questions.explanation: and then 表依次发生的动作 → 一般过去时。

questions.stem: "The son ____ (enter) the room and sat down at the table."
questions.explanation: and 连接的两个先后动作 → 一般过去时。

questions.stem: "When the curtain fell, the whole family ____ (clap) loudly."
questions.explanation: 幕落'后'紧接的反应动作 → 一般过去时。

questions.stem: "After the argument, the family finally ____ (settle) their differences."
questions.explanation: After the argument 之后发生的动作 → 一般过去时。
